# ComfyUI's environment (88ab4a06, the commit comfyui_unit::COMMIT names) for
# linux-x86_64 with CUDA 13, every file pinned by sha256: the versions the
# hand-built ComfyUI ran on the GB10, 2026-10-10, torch 2.14.0+cu130.
#
# torch and torchvision are direct URLs to one wheel each on
# download.pytorch.org/whl/cu130, carrying that wheel's sha256 alone; every
# other package is PyPI's. No second index is ever consulted, so nothing else
# can be taken from it (uv's dependency-confusion rule). Regenerate with:
#   req.in = ComfyUI's requirements.txt at the commit, less the bare `torch`
#            and `torchvision` lines, plus
#            torch @ <cu130 wheel URL>#sha256=<its sha256>
#            torchvision @ <cu130 wheel URL>#sha256=<its sha256>
#   rm -f out.txt   # an existing output is read as preferences, stale hashes and all
#   uv pip compile req.in -c <the running venv's pip freeze, less torch*> \
#     --python-version 3.12 --python-platform x86_64-manylinux_2_28 \
#     --generate-hashes --no-header -o out.txt
# then give each direct-URL line its fragment's hash as its only --hash
# (uv lists PyPI's torch hashes there too).
